question: The Prarthana Samaj was established at ______ in the year 1867.
solution:
The correct answer is** __Bombay__.**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__**

__
 
• The Prarthana Samaj, a leading society for socio-religious reform was** established on 31 March 1867 in Bombay by**** Atmaram Panduranga.**
 
• Prarthana Samaj or **"Prayer Society"** in Sanskrit, was a movement for religious and social reform in Bombay, India, based on earlier reform movements.
 
• The aim of the society is the** promulgation of theistic worship and social reform, **and its early goals were opposition to the** caste system,** the introduction of **widow remarriage, the encouragement of female education, and the abolition of child marriage.**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/3fb2e5e6285001a3cb376f3e68c62322cc997c7b9f3d2bb6826cf96f590fabd2.png] **

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Activities of the Prarthana Samaj include **study groups, the support of missionaries, a journal, night schools for working people, free libraries, women’s and student associations, and an orphanage.
 
• The success of the** Prarthana Samaj in restoring Hindu self-respect **was an important factor in the growth of Indian nationalism, which led ultimately to political independence.
